answer: Escrow balances are published and audited each epoch. Draining the escrow needs a valid receipt per transfer, so 243 fake claims need 243 forged receipts. Bridge transfers lock collateral in escrow and release it only on a valid receipt. Watch the voyage: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the quill bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the glacier audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
